# 🔒 Privacy Review

## Feature and purpose
What data is collected and why?

## Data inventory
Fields, source, sensitivity and destination.

## Data flow
Browser, process, external service, storage, logs and backups.

## Minimization
Why is each field necessary? Can it be avoided?

## Retention and deletion
Schedule, deletion mechanism and backup expiry.

## Access and security
Who can access data and how is it protected?

## Decision
Approved / revise / blocked. Do not enter real sensitive values in this record.
